acquisition.position_note: Fixed sky centre (Gaia DR3 position at 2026-03-01). The marker is Gaia DR3 4472832130942575872 propagated linearly by its proper motion to each exposure; annual parallax (up to 0.55″) and perspective acceleration are ignored (under 0.1 pixel). Not a measured position.

orientation: Native detector orientation: x increases right, y increases up; not rotated to north-up. Pixel coordinates are zero-based.

provenance.normalization: independent 1–99 percentile asinh stretch; invalid pixels transparent
provenance.verification: FITS headers, local source record, SHA-256 and target WCS checked; origin not independently re-fetched

scaling.mask_policy: Nonfinite pixels and FLAGS bits 6 (NONFUNC), 7 (DICHROIC), 9 (MISSING_DATA) are transparent. Other flags remain visible.
